recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-17421 unless a future work-group decision changes how CanonicalResource.version applies to CompartmentDefinition.
issue_request: FHIR-17421 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CompartmentDefinition change request, raised and applied for STU3, asking to add version to CompartmentDefinition because compartment definitions change release to release and are harder to manage without a version.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 13942. Git history contains 1f8804d552b77083b3e7975fd97109ba48e54c6e, 'GF#17421 - add CompartmentDefinition.version', which added a CompartmentDefinition.version row to the then-authoritative source/compartmentdefinition/compartmentdefinition-spreadsheet.xml and regenerated implementation artifacts.
additional_context: The old spreadsheet source was later replaced by current StructureDefinition XML source. source/fhir.ini actively includes compartmentdefinition as CompartmentDefinition and marks the resource with current maturity/status metadata. Current source/compartmentdefinition/structuredefinition-CompartmentDefinition.xml includes CompartmentDefinition.version, and source/compartmentdefinition/bundle-CompartmentDefinition-search-params.xml includes the matching version search parameter. Later canonical-resource work, including FHIR-26370's versionAlgorithm[x], retained rather than superseded the version element. Jira link checks found no direct linked issue requiring different treatment, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no substantive conflicting community decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build source already carries CompartmentDefinition.version with canonical business-version wording and the corresponding search parameter. Rewriting the element would be redundant and could drift from shared CanonicalResource wording.

related_jiras.note: Later canonical-resource work added versionAlgorithm[x] next to version; it did not remove or alter the FHIR-17421 version element.
